notes.title: The Cable Game runs free January 2022!
notes.notes:
[b]Developer's Tidings[/b]

Hi all,

here's an important notice concerning Kaapelipeli: The Cable Game... It will transform into a free game during January 2022! This is a step I'm willing to take because I just want to share this game through Steam and possibly generate a community around this game, which in turn will encourage more players to join the World of Kaapelipeli. Increased player counts can also inspire me to make more content in the future, free. 

Thank you all who dared to purchase this game during the last 1,5 years. May the spirit of The Cable Game aid you in upcoming battles. 


You can still support and buy the game during this transformation, though you can wait 'till it's purely free, this is ok too.

Let's Cable, for free this time
- IP

notes.title: Cable Game is back with Version 1.52! Dig into summer with this and TBA-material
notes.notes:
Version 1.52 in a nutshell:

Features and Changes:
* Mystery character is here to help you solve murders and clues! Who might s/he be? I think you don't need a pair of moustaches to figure this one out  : 3 ) 
* From a sweaty sauna, enter Saunameister who is here to help as well
* Random Level Mode added! Push the RNG-button to start from a random level and be ready for anything
* Beach Boss-level is now more challenging in normal mode and Boss-mode
* Sandy Pyramids level received an update
* Lady characters bought new cosmetics from Summer Sales
* Le Grill? What the heck is that?
* Outhouse? Does it come with a toilet?
* Starting Screen/Main menu has new text UI
* Beware of Paupers! They are new 'Down-and-out' beggar enemies that want your pocket money and don't hesitate to take it!
* To compensate the fastessness of some characters, shot Drills are now even faster
* New Vehicles added: Hat-van and Stovematic!

Fixes:
^ When teleporting to Snowy-levels, sound is now played correctly
^ Some Snow piles were moved to better suited places, snowy trees too
^ Beach Rescue -level now plays audio correctly
^ Desert Pirayas now 'splat' when hit with a Contract
^ Slender File Optimizing

notes.title: Play together! Local 2P-Multiplayer update is here
notes.notes:
Version 1.45 released today on Halloween Friday 9/30/2020 with:

Local 2-Player mode!
[list]
 [*] 2-P mode can be activated from the Options
 [*] Player 2 has his own health and he can be moved with keyboards arrow-keys. 
 [*] This player however, can't shoot very often nor pick up most items. He can be used as a  helper to remove trees without penalties and to place sticks though!
 [*] Player 2 can shoot with ”0”-button but only once every X seconds
 [*] If he ”dies”, he'll respawn at the start of every level for free.
 [*] He has an immunity against most of the angry landowners but in turn he's very vulnerable to flying sharp objects and tractors!
 [*] Who ordered pizza? Only Player 2 may pick it up & it increases both bullets and points!
 [*] P2 can't place sticks while in digging mode 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.30: Annoying neighbours and painful traps
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019764/1aac09c9bc618c28aa7cedd19e8fea38677b1def.png[/img]

This Friday's update to Version 1.30 includes the following:

Annoying neighbours and painful traps update:
◦ More randomness & awesomeness added to the game in a form of new enemies and obstacles! Get ready to avoid beartraps, eager hunters, smelly composts, expansive forest fires, and hypersocial grandmas! 

◦ Luckily this update also introduces Workers! Workers can be found randomly while exploring levels and they give player bonus points while digging through marked routes which is very nice! Please note that 
these guys are very squishy and have only 1 Hp. Their amount is also limited to two individuals.

◦ Gigantic Landowners have been sighted! These massive owners can take many hits before going down!

• Game now has it's own a tiny golf course! 

• Introducing a new playable character: Assassin!

+ Many fixes and enhancements!


Let's Cable!

ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update 1.2. is here with Boss-mode, Speed-mode & Followers
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019764/2339ba40f13030d058277cf18d67a7d4a821b50e.gif[/img]

Features and Changes:

Introducing Speed- and Boss-modes
◦ Boss-mode, like name infers, lets player face all bosses sequentially (in order, no rest). Points aren't a factor anymore, because survival is the key!
◦ Speed-mode increases player's overall speed (shooting and moving) while keeping the main game otherwise normal. However, player may find more Speed-boosts than usual.
◦ New modes can be found in Level select screen

Followers are here ːcozytreshconeː ːsteamhappyː ːcozysmitedajiː
* You may already have encountered some of us: We are cute little critters that player may capture and use as travel companions! We aid you the best way we can ;-)
* After capturing a follower, player may select it in the main menu
* All followers have a 'unique' skill they can use

Watch out for Fire giants! ːcozycastondeathː
* These fiery spirited landowners can absorb many hits before turning into ash and smoke. Meanwhile they storm around and are just mean beings.


Fixes:
• Levels 1-4 received facelifts! Which means more space to move and to dig in those levels!
• Boring trees now give -1 point when cut down and -2 points when bulldozed
• Level select screen should now remember unlocked levels even after player resets levels.

notes.title: Gamekey Giveaway - Profession Simulator Competition
notes.notes:
Storage hunters, cleaners, divers, skaters, farmers etc. are popular game formats or job simulators that can be found nowadays quite easily.
 
Therefore, our new [b]Free Gamekey Competition[/b] is about naming a Profession or Industry that hasn't been made into a game yet. For example, I bet Steam doesn't have a Karaoke Bar -simulator or Dolphin Circus -game for sale. (Just some quick examples! And bad ones ːberserkː ). 

Best and Worst suggestions get rewarded with a Free Kaapelipeli: The Cable Game Gamekey!  

ːtowngemː  ːtowngemː  ːtowngemː

Read the Rules below and Post your suggestion here with a brief explanation, some arguments or with a funny image. 

Rules:
* Ideas must be original and realistic, e.g.  Dragon Tamer School is not possible in our World (sadly).
* Avoid copying ideas from others ːsansː
* You can take part with only one idea, choose carefully!
* Competition time is July 13th - July 31st. 
* Winners get their keys and well-earned fame after competition is over.

Why?
* Because Kaapelipeli: The Cable Game is the world's only simulation/profession game about planning and digging power cable routes!

ːwinter2019coolyulː  ːwinter2019coolyulː  ːwinter2019coolyulː

notes.title: Launch & Life After Launch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019764/ca545723e8c670cbbc4de1a062f76b536258b852.png[/img]

Hello Cable Gamers, all familiar faces and hopefully some new ones who just have discovered this indie piece from Steam or another source.

This post is about Cable Game's near future, i.e. what will happen after this Fateful Friday, July 10th, is over and Cable Game's Steam release has been successful. 

First, many things are up to you. I will read all the possible feedback from you and take notes whether some nice and important suggestions pop up!

Secondly, I have a comprehensive update schedule already planned, which will feature both bug fixes and new content for all you players. I think updates will emerge every 1-2 weeks, but it's not carved in stone, e.g. game breaking bugs will be squished immediately!

New content will include these plus more:
* Boss- and Speed-modes will be unlocked
* Follower-system is introduced
* More Achievements
* New Bonus levels 
* New enemies and obstacles 
* Etc. Etc. + your suggestions and ideas!

Kaapelipeli: The Cable Game and Ei Kait Siinä Studios will continue this journey together with all of you! 

~ IP from Ei kait Siinä Studios

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019764/c7ab167e7140d5471dd9e0abfe0d10be1640fdf5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38019764/3aff1104cd0376c3d932db0d6f2ee8d44cbd73a9.png[/img][/url]


PS.
Below you can learn the short history of Kaapelipeli:
First seed of Kaapelipeli was sown in autumn 2017 when the idea of world's only cable game was brought to the coffee table. It all started as a joke but suddenly a coding free game developer tool - Gamesalad was discovered, and first steps were taken. 

The game continued to develop during the next two years. Usually because some real-life experiences affected game's main idea and inspiration to add more & more grew. After some time (and some inside jokes about the game) many rpg-elements were added: Coffee mugs became health and player gained ability to shoot contracts. Soon rpg-elements emerged to give game more depth. 

In November 2019, Instagram-account was established to spread the news and updates more easily.

In 2019, after a lot of testing and more added content, Kaapelipeli was released to Google Play as a first beta version. This beta version was shelved after a while though. During Summer of 2019 The Official Demo Version was released in Google Play and Gamesalad Arcade. 

After some struggles, a working desktop demo version was released during spring 2020.

in May/June Steam page was established and it passed Steam's evaluations soon after.

Full Steam release is set to be July 10th! Meanwhile development continues!
